title: Lumière Solitaire Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
One larger light, in a line of ovals. Oval cut clear cubic zirconia of about 5mm by 3mm are set crosswise, each turned so its long axis runs across the row and held at its flanks by slim gold claws. At the centre sits one larger round brilliant stone of about 7mm in its own four claw setting, so the bracelet has a front. A slim gold box clasp closes it. Wear it to a wedding with the solitaire on top of the wrist.

STYLING TIP: Turn the solitaire to the top of the wrist and wear it alone.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stone: Oval cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 5mm by 3mm, set crosswise
  • Centre stone: One round brilliant clear cubic zirconia, approximately 7mm, in a four claw setting
  • Setting: Slim gold claws at the flanks of every stone, linked directly
  • Closure: Box clasp
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
